capabilities: Run coding agents in split terminal panes and tabs
Keep agent sessions alive across tab closes and reloads
Show agent status as working, blocked or done in Mission Control
Let agents read and edit notes through a local Vault Control Bridge
Log every agent edit and roll it back
disambiguation: Not a project or task manager; Mission Control is a status board for running terminal agents.
extras: Desktop only (Obsidian 1.14.4+); makes no network calls and needs no account or API keys; UI control is off by default and blocked in protected areas; macOS and Windows are untested; Flatpak builds stop agents when Obsidian quits.
problem: Coding agents run outside Obsidian, so they cannot safely read or edit vault notes, and their sessions stop when the app reloads.

relations.evidence: It needs Herdr, which you install yourself.
UI control comes from Obsidian Control Center, also by Daniel.

summary: Terminal workspace that runs persistent coding-agent sessions inside Obsidian and lets them read and edit notes through a logged, undoable bridge.
